en: A follower of the Demon Duke Hilde, though not a very loyal one. Once an undead thing of nothing but bones, Makakuri traveled in search of a body of flesh and blood. With that goal achieved, Makakuri now only gets moving, grudgingly, when Ruu nags. Lazy, and quick to run away.
note: No pronoun for Makakuri (source gives none).

en: A follower of the Demon Duke Hilde. Under the law of the wasteland, where the weak are culled, she lost her place in the world, and she has sworn loyalty to Hilde, who gave her a safe haven. This time she has been asked to search for a certain woman. But who could that be?
note: Gender: the source says [JP] here (evidence for the glossary, which has Ruu as unknown). [JP] = 'wasteland' as in wmap slice_20.

en: A tiger lord of majestic bearing. Mandelgius was apparently roaming the land for some purpose with a friend named Rondelgius, but the two got separated along the way.
note: New name: Rondelgius ([JP], mirrors Mandelgius). No pronoun for Mandelgius: the source gives none.

en: A Valkyrie girl. She once guarded the Temple of Rafa, but her habit of doing things at her own pace led to failure after failure, and she was thrown out. Since then, she seems to be scraping by as an adventurer.
A girl raised in the Perpeco Forest. An alchemist, she came to Algrantz seeking the money and know-how to rebuild her village, which was attacked by monsters.
note: The source itself calls Electra [JP] (girl), so 'girl'/'she' translate this row; the glossary still lists Electra's gender as unknown and could be updated from this row. 'her village' (Perpeco Village) is implied.

en: A unicorn who has been with Electra since they were both little. Having always eaten and slept alongside people, Mig is convinced of deserving the same treatment as any human.
note: No pronoun for Mig (glossary gender unknown).

en: An adventurer working as a bounty hunter. Yamuru teamed up with Electra because they shared the same interest: making money. Lately, though, Electra has been holding Yamuru back, and with the bounty hunting so inefficient, Yamuru has begun to wonder if going solo would be better.
note: No pronoun for Yamuru (glossary gender unknown).

en: A girl fascinated by the legends of the Moonlight Spirit. Puzzled that there are so many legends of the Sun Spirit and almost none of the Moonlight Spirit, she set out to find them herself. Caught in a trap and unable to move, she was rescued by Yamuru, and has traveled with Yamuru ever since.
note: The source calls Maniron [JP] (girl).

en: An old bishop who lay collapsed after a monster attack until Electra came to the rescue. Partly out of gratitude, Korbitz now travels with Electra, meaning to spend the years left supporting someone so accident-prone. Korbitz thinks of Electra as a grandchild and holds Electra very dear.
note: No pronouns for Korbitz or Electra (glossary genders unknown); 'old bishop' is gender-neutral.

en: Mokero ran with a gang of thieves in the Crotoa City Ruins, but after attacking Electra's party, got beaten back, was lectured by Electra and turned over a new leaf. Ever since, Mokero has called Electra 'Miss' and has been with Electra's party, putting skills from those thieving days to use.
note: [JP] = 'Miss' (glossary), in single quotes for the source's brackets. No pronouns for Mokero/Electra.

en: Tiny Reckdas look-alikes emerging from deep in the fog Reckdas gives off. Don't drop your guard because they're small or mere illusions. The land's common sense doesn't apply to Demon Dukes. Treat each as the Demon Duke in person, only smaller, or countless Petitdas will swarm you, leaving you a pitiful sight.
note: Source line breaks fall every 12 full-width chars (ruler wrap, mid-word) and stop after line 7, so they are wrap points, not meaningful lines; English is left unbroken like the other MON_TEXT/ITEM_TEXT rows. New name: Petitdas ([JP] = petit + Reckdas).

en:
A beastman of bizarre appearance.
On first meeting, all are shocked by... First?
Perhaps you have met him before. He has come back here now, far more powerful than he ever was. Whether you knew him before or are seeing him for the first time, you would do well to be very careful.
note: Kept the source's two line breaks (they carry the interrupted 'shocked by...' gag). Line 3 is one long unbroken line, as in the source, so it relies on the game's wrapping like the other rows. [JP] = he.
